remarks: Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in highly sought-after Silvermine, this well-maintained 4-bed Colonial offers a spacious and well-proportioned layout on a beautiful, level .53-acre property steps away from the babbling Silvermine Brook and dog-friendly open space. Freshly painted & move-in ready, the home features a spacious, functional layout with hardwood floors, sun-filled rooms, and a 1,100 sq ft finished lower level ideal for recreation, a home office, or workout space. The expansive front yard creates a welcoming presence with exceptional curb appeal, while the private backyard is a true retreat-featuring mature plantings, natural screening, and a serene oasis. Two generous decks provide the perfect backdrop for outdoor entertaining or quiet relaxation surrounded by nature. A rare highlight is the double-height two-car garage ideal for car enthusiasts or additional storage. Located in the heart of Silvermine, one of Fairfield County's most picturesque and historic enclaves, this home offers classic Colonial style with thoughtful updates and a convenient location. Known for its picturesque setting, Silvermine has a rich artistic heritage anchored by the Silvermine Arts Center. Residents enjoy a strong sense of community with local favorites like the Silvermine Market, GrayBarns Tavern, and nearby golf & park facilities. Just minutes to the Merritt Pkwy, Merritt 7, SoNo train stations, this "hidden gem" location offers easy access to NYC.
